The Catdetlist has been deprecated and replaced by Jupiter Verify.

The Catdetlist portal has been deprecated and replaced by Jupiter Verify, our V3 token list system. You no longer need to submit applications. Instead, tokens with a good organic score and community support(measured by smart likes) will be discovered naturally and verified.

To get your community to submit smart likes, go to the token page of your token and like it.

Just a reminder: Verification is our way of helping users find the correct token at the right mint address, and is not an endorsement of any project.
